notes.title: Update 1.1 – Map selection on multiplayer and Spanish!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265385/43172037e8256e317b323ec2312d3b7ceea72243.png[/img]

Hello guys! How are you doing?

You can now play on the other maps on the online multiplayer mode! After knowing all paths from the Village by heart, guess it’s time to explore new regions of Almerath. We’ve also added Spanish to the available languages, thanks to David de la Nuez!

Here is a summary of what has changed:

[list]
[*]Added map selection on the online multiplayer mode (Custom Room);
[*]Added random map on the online multiplayer mode (Quick Match);
[*]Added Spanish to the available languages;
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the "Don't touch me!" achievement from unlocking in some cases;
[*]Fixed a bug that prevented the joystick controller from properly working when using Liz on a multiplayer match;
[*]Bug fixes and improvements.
 [/list]


[h1]New maps on the multiplayer mode (Online)[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265385/98f76c680bc3b9bc9d9edbd024d22625efdfe235.png[/img]

All maps are now available for playing on the online multiplayer mode. If you are in a custom lobby (the one you can invite friends), the leader of the room will be able to select the desired map on the list. The available maps on this list will depend on having a player inside the room that has already bought it. In other word, you can play a map even if you haven’t bought it yet, as long as someone among you and your friends has already unlocked it.
The availability of maps works the same way on a Quick Match, but it will be randomly selected before starting the game.

[h1]Spanish Localization[/h1]

Pigeons Attack is now fully localized into Spanish! The localization was done by David de la Nuez Medina. Thank you David for the amazing job! If Spanish is your native language and you want to switch to it, just visit the “Options”menu to change. The language should initialize as default for new players.



Hope you are having fun playing the game!

Don’t forget to leave your suggestions and requests.

Thank you!

notes.title: Update 1.0.1 - Invite Friends
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265385/61e209fd6243ce2f8f32b150a4aa5a9e366f3377.png[/img]

Hello guys! How are you doing?

The option to invite friends is finally live! Just follow these simple steps:

[list]
[*]Open the online mode as usually;
[*]There is now a selection called "Custom Room";
[*]After creating the room, invite your friends!
[/list]

Forgive us for not having this feature since day one and thank you all for playing the game!

We'll continue updating the game, specially the online mode. The next things we're going to focus are making it easy to play again with your friends (not needing to invite to a new room after game over and being able to play in other maps as well).


If you find any wierd bug, please let us know.


Thank you again for your patience and for playing Pigeons Attack!

tags.feature: The option to invite friends is finally live!

notes.title: Update 1.0 – Out of Early Access!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265385/c0663b4d70da957e8e2794b0a5c8daf1b33ccd32.png[/img]

Hello guys! How are you doing?

The day has finally come! Pigeons Attack is now out of Early Access mode and officially released on Steam! But don’t worry, this doesn’t mean the game won’t receive more cool stuff in the future.

Here is a summary of what has changed:
[list]
[*]Increased lightmap resolution, in other words, shadows look better now;
[*]Added an option to toggle Ambient Occlusion effect;
[*]Fixed a bug in the online multiplayer mode where sometimes death and life amount weren’t synchronized;
[*]Bug fixes and overall improvements.
 [/list]


[h1]Thank you very much![/h1]
As a solo indie developer, seeing people playing my game was my main fuel to continue the project, despite all the problems faced. Specially during face-to-face events, where I was able to hear the players laughing, making jokes and puns about pigeons and having fun with the game. That’s an awesome feeling that I wish all devs can experience it as well, in case you’re one or plan to be. The critics and suggestions were vital to improve the game. The online and local co-op mode were requests that you guys kept asking me, to name a few, and I’m really glad to have added them to the game.

Well, before I start crying and wet my keyboard (one must not show weakness while pigeons are watching), I would like to thank you all for playing the game! Thank you early access players, new players or if you just whishlisted it. Thank you for the suggestions, critics and for following/supporting the project for so long.


Hope you have fun playing the game, alone or with your friends!
Don’t forget to leave your suggestions and requests.



Thank you!

notes.title: Update 0.9.8 - Achievements!
notes.content:
Hello guys! How are you doing?

We've added achievements to the game! Now you don't need to take a screenshot of your accomplishment to prove to your jealous friend that you made it to round 20. Just show off your achievement on your profile ;)

[h1]Some questions that may pop in:[/h1]

[b]I've already bought all the maps, how do I get the achievement now?[/b]

Don't worry, just open the game and the Steam achievements should appear as soon as you enter the main menu scene.

[b]My highscore shows that I've already reached round X, but no achievement appears[/b]

Thanks for playing the game and making it that far, but unfortunately you'll have to reach it again to be able to unlock the achievement. The game difficulty has been tweaked throughout the versions, so the achievement will show that everyone faced the same challenges to unlock it. Sorry about that.



I'm curious to see the strategies you'll use to unlock some difficult achievements. Hope you have fun completing them all.

Thanks for playing and for reading!

notes.title: Update 0.9.5 – Online Multiplayer!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265385/5c56780fcb759bf97a0ad9569e2a327c361d17b4.png[/img]


Hello guys! How are you doing?

You asked, we did it: online multiplayer is now available on today’s update! You can play together with 3 more friends and help save the world from the evil pigeons (or join them by throwing bombs at your “allies”). The multiplayer is still in beta, so if you experience some weird bug, please let us know.


Here is a summary of what has changed. You can read more details below it:

[list]
[*]Added Online Multiplayer mode (up to 4 players);
[*]Local Coop mode now supports 4 players (joysticks required);
[*]Bug fixes and improvements.
 [/list]


Check out the new stuff by watching this uncomment gameplay :
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8mUppMOMGh4


Now, the details…


[h1]Online Multiplayer[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265385/c0a95fd4b3b2179475ca558ca41be15eb4ac3fbb.png[/img]


You can finally fight pigeons with all your friends or other players through the online multiplayer mode! It supports up to 4 players, no joystick required (but if you want, you can use it). 

This beta works with a quick match lobby: you enter in a random room and wait for other players to join the lobby as well. As soon as another player comes in, the countdown of 10 seconds begins and if no one else enters, the game starts with the minimum of 2 players. That means, if you want to play with your friends, you should pay attention to the countdown so no one is left behind.

Don’t worry, we will implement an option for creating a custom room in further updates.


Hope you have fun playing the new multiplayer mode! Please let us know if you have some suggestions or found a weird bug :D

Thanks for the support!

notes.title: New Character available: Ron, the Mage! Update 0.8
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32265385/47e224e556877750b61693288dfc35881f1b9dec.png[/img]

Hello guys! How are you doing?

Yes, you read it right. You can now play with a new character on Pigeons Attack! Here is a summary of new stuff added on update 0.8:

[list]
[*]New playable character: Ron, The Mage;
[*]Giant Pigeon has a new behavior;
[*]You can now add any weapon/item (according to character) in any inventory slot;
[*]Minor speed decrease on tiny pink pigeon;
[*]Bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]


Now, let’s get to the details.

[h1]Ron, The Mage[/h1]
Ron uses magic staffs as weapon (don’t you say). You can find different staffs on different spots of the map, each one with a specific power. They all work in a similar way: press the attack button once to shoot and hold it for a while (until you hear a sound or see your staff glowing) to shoot its special power, as you can see on the gifs. But be careful, all your shots consume mana (blue bar below health). The amount of mana consumed depends on which staff you are using and if it is a normal or a special shot. You can recover your mana by defeating enemies, picking ammo boxes, buying mana potions or just waiting, as it recovers a bit every second.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jyutx2Cpd8m6XNjPaj/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/jy7MVimGSvqBBXMtv0/giphy.gif[/img]


Manage your mana so you can use this awesome and powerful ultimate when your bar is full:

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/82wVCt42jfsd766a9o/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]Giant Pigeon’s new behavior[/h1]
Giant Pigeons will now try to block your path (saying “excuse me” to them will not work, we tried) by standing still on the closest open path. They only will chase you when there is no free spot available or when they are the only enemies left on the current round.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/7J7qUj7eMyFonaINFq/giphy.gif[/img]


[h1]Inventory slot[/h1]
On previous versions, the third slot of your inventory was only used by certain weapons, like health potion, bombs etc. Now, you can place any weapon on any slot, as long as your character is allowed to use it. So, this means you can hold three machine guns or three health potions. No idea on how you would attack with the last combination, but it is up to you what combination of weapons and items you want to use.


Hope you enjoy playing with Ron! Please, feel free to send us feedback about the new character, any other suggestion or bug.

notes.title: Update 0.7.4.2 + Coins
notes.content:
Hello there!

Update 0.7.4.2 is now live! Here is what changed:

[list]
[*]Fixed bug where pigeons nests (from pink pigeons) weren’t taking damage from explosions (bombs, for example);
[*]Adjusted amount of coins you get during the match. Now you will get (at least) 3x more coins than the previous versions!
[/list]

It was taking too much time and effort to collect and save coins to buy and unlock new stuff, such as maps. Players tend to spend this gold on runes so they can reach higher rounds and collect more coins (or just to try them out), but the amount was so low that what they were getting was just enough to pay what they had invested. 

You can finally have fun playing on new maps! And keep spending on runes, of course…

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/BjW5Y1p0l3NR4lFAgd/giphy.gif[/img]

Wow! Much coins!

notes.title: Update 0.7.4.1 + Bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello there!

Update 0.7.4.1 (a lot of numbers and dots, I know) is now live! This update fixes some bugs and brings some small changes to the game:

[list]
[*]Fixed bug that was making pigeons stand still forever when using the "Popcorn";
[*]Fixed bug that you could stay trapped inside the sidewalk after getting hit by an enemy on map one;
[*]You can now swap weapons using the scroll wheel;
[*]Tweaked difficulty of the white pigeon.
[/list]

After a really intense discussion with the pigeons from Kingdom of Pruuzharia, they ordered the white pigeon (that one who poops on all over your screen) to calm down and make things a little easier with humans. The explosion delay was changed from 0.6 to 0.8 seconds and the duration of the effect from 5 to 4 seconds.


[h1]Thank you for playing![/h1]

I would like to thank you all for buying and playing Pigeons Attack. I hope you guys are enjoying the game so far. I’ll do by best to improve it and bring a lot of new stuff.


That’s all for today’s update.


May the pigeons be away from you.
